Question 14
?

The ratio of dogs to the total number of pets in a veterinary clinic is 2:5. What is the meaning of this ratio?

a
Out of every 5 pets in the clinic, 2 of them are dogs
b
The clinic has exactly 2 dogs
c
The clinic has exactly 5 pets
d
Out of every 2 pets in the clinic, 5 of them are dogs
e
The clinic has exactly 7 pets
